name: Super Mario Bros. (iNES, mapper 0, NTSC)
description: SMB1 tuning on top of the generic vision layer. The player position is read from the OAM sprite table at $0200, which was measured on the Virtual Console build and is trusted on its own. The HUD addresses below are community-documented and read as zeros on that build, so only the fields listed in `invariants` are trusted and everything else degrades to 'unknown' rather than guessing.
goal: Reach the flagpole at the right end of the level.
